label: Fires on the word immediately before a ' for' that is the locked-in next token of a collocation or institutional name (cause for concern, Department for X, take no for an answer, dollar for dollar, strapped for cash, pound for pound, paid for by, cares for), i.e. a next-token predictor of a near-certain collocational ' for' that still fires when the collocation is broken ('cause of concern'), and stays quiet where 'for' is only likely rather than locked in (thank you for, waiting for, keys for me) and on the same words outside the collocation (verb cause, US Department of).

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit
